topic: Part 3: the $3,300 eBay charity pizza (Pizza Royale 007)
style: Photorealistic luxury food look, dark and rich with gold accents
requestedEnding: Asks the viewer whether they would bid, then promises more

storyArc.protagonist: A gold, lobster and caviar pizza sold on eBay
storyArc.setting: dark luxury kitchen counters and an Italian wood oven
storyArc.goal: Show the record pizza you could actually bid on.
storyArc.obstacle: Why would anyone pay over three thousand dollars for one pizza?
storyArc.turn: Shop price GBP 750 vs auction GBP 2,150, sold for charity.
storyArc.visualBible: Dark marble, candlelight, gold and amber accents, photorealistic food photography, no people faces.

plan.title: Part 3: The $3,300 eBay Pizza Sold for Charity
plan.hook: This eBay pizza sold for over three thousand dollars, yet helped charity.
plan.payoff: Would you bid three thousand dollars on a pizza? Follow for more!
claimsToCheck: Guinness World Records, Most expensive pizza sold at an online auction: GBP 2,150 (about US$3,321), Pizza Royale (Domenico Crolla), eBay, buyer an Italian lawyer, sold for charity; toppings lobster marinated in cognac, Beluga caviar, fillet steak marinated in Scotch, smoked salmon, edible gold leaf, white Italian truffles; normal retail price GBP 750 at a Glasgow shop (guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/84911-most-expensive-pizza-sold-at-an-online-auction). Checked 9 Nov 2026

Irish Examiner (Nov 2006): made by Glasgow restaurateur Domenico Crolla for the Casino Royale premiere, 12-inch (irishexaminer.com/world/arid-20018012.html). Pre-sale article; charity name left out of the narration
Dates conflict (Guinness 2007, newspaper Nov 2006) so no year is spoken. Guinness says 'Louis VIII' cognac (typo), so only 'cognac' appears in the image prompt, not narrated.
The gavel and a counter are illustrative visuals only.
